controls.purpose: Keep destructive host backup and storage operations outside claims of repository-local machine enforcement.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent must verify external backup state and host-operation safety before destructive work.
controls.boundary: The decisive state and operation live outside the repository and wrapper process.

controls.purpose: Track the boundary between repository-side Codex auto-resume transaction checks and the external automation write.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent remains responsible for the external automation mutation and for interpreting provider-side outcomes.
controls.boundary: Repository code validates transaction evidence, but the automation service write is not fully machine-owned here.

controls.purpose: Keep continuous-improvement capture identified as a semantic parent responsibility rather than a wrapper invariant.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent decides whether an observed problem merits a durable improvement item and how to phrase it.
controls.boundary: Whether an observation is materially reusable is a semantic judgment.

controls.purpose: Keep direct-edit authority grounded in the user's instruction rather than falsely attributing it to repository machinery.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent determines whether the current user request grants the exact direct-edit authority being exercised.
controls.boundary: The authoritative user request is external conversation input.

controls.purpose: Keep escaped-cause classification explicit as a semantic analysis responsibility.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent determines the causal classification and whether a distinct follow-up is warranted.
controls.boundary: Causal meaning cannot be proven from structural repository state alone.

controls.purpose: Track repository-side execution-permission state without claiming ownership of external approval decisions.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent interprets external execution denials and chooses an allowed next action.
controls.boundary: Machine state is available locally, but the external approval reviewer or sandbox decision is not repository-owned.

controls.purpose: Reject implementation admission when the active task lacks the required external-feasibility declaration or evidence shape.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent judges whether the declared external premise and producer evidence are semantically sufficient.

controls.purpose: Track mechanical handling of failure artifacts without claiming that arbitrary sensitive content can be recognized exhaustively.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent must judge whether produced artifacts contain sensitive material that structural filters cannot identify.
controls.boundary: Known artifact boundaries are machine-controlled, but arbitrary semantic confidentiality is not.

controls.purpose: Track the boundary between repository-side GLM auto-resume transaction checks and the external automation write.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent remains responsible for external automation mutation and for interpreting provider-side outcomes.
controls.boundary: Repository code validates transaction evidence, but the automation service write is not fully machine-owned here.

controls.purpose: Keep goal/task review disposition as an explicit semantic parent responsibility.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent decides whether implementation satisfies the goal and how unresolved semantic findings affect disposition.
controls.boundary: Goal satisfaction is not reducible to structural state or command success.

controls.purpose: Terminalize watch only when error material and lock ownership prove the watched task is orphaned.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent decides the semantic recovery or disposition after consuming orphan-terminal evidence.

controls.purpose: Constrain worker and reviewer structured results to the machine packet schema and validation contract.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent still evaluates the substantive meaning of a structurally valid packet.

controls.purpose: Admit parent actions only through staged payload and lifecycle checks that match the current task state.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent chooses among machine-admitted semantic actions; the staging layer only proves admissibility and payload binding.

controls.purpose: Project parent-visible evidence under a scoped lease and suppress duplicate bodies without losing the canonical claim boundary.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent chooses which evidence questions matter and interprets the projected evidence semantically.

controls.purpose: Prevent worker model calls from silently changing parent-managed plan and task metadata.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent decides the intended metadata repair or authorized update after a fail-closed stop.

controls.purpose: Track the machine-visible parent continuation state without claiming the whole continuation decision is mechanical.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent decides the semantic continuation after reading the machine state and task outcome.
controls.boundary: Continuation state is machine-projected, while the next semantic action remains a parent decision.

controls.purpose: Keep parent wait ownership visible without falsely registering prose routing as a machine-enforced invariant.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent follows the documented wait ownership convention.
controls.boundary: No production owner rejects violations of this ownership rule.

controls.purpose: Bind quality validation evidence to the current handoff and repository snapshot before final parent acceptance.

controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent performs the final semantic acceptance after the machine proves validation freshness and snapshot binding.

controls.purpose: Block task completion until local final state is proven synchronized with the bound remote branch.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent performs or authorizes the remote write; the machine only proves the required synchronization postcondition.

controls.purpose: Activate deterministic full-corpus search when the task contract explicitly requires exhaustive search evidence.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent or model must still judge whether the chosen predicate is semantically sufficient for the requested exhaustive claim.

controls.purpose: Keep reviewer execution on a reviewer role/session with read-only capability distinct from implementation worker execution.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent evaluates reviewer findings and final acceptance; machine separation does not make review semantics mechanical.

controls.purpose: Track runtime-install evidence required for completion without claiming all installation effects are repository-local.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent evaluates whether external runtime installation evidence is sufficient for the intended environment.
controls.boundary: Completion checks are mechanical, but the installed runtime environment has effects beyond repository state.

controls.purpose: Bind session rotation claim, new thread identity, and task start through one coherent machine lifecycle.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent decides when rotation is semantically appropriate and owns external creation of the new Codex thread.

controls.purpose: Track machine failure evidence for session rotation without promoting external thread-creation failure proof to full enforcement.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent interprets external thread-creation failure and decides whether and how to retry or recover.
controls.boundary: Repository state records failure evidence, but thread creation occurs outside the repository process.

controls.purpose: Track machine evidence bindings used before Sol acceptance without treating semantic review quality as mechanical.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent must actually evaluate the relevant evidence and findings before acceptance.
controls.boundary: Evidence availability and binding are machine-checkable; substantive review remains semantic.

controls.purpose: Keep stop, interrupted isolation, and parent-wait park/unpark transitions within their distinct machine lifecycle states.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent decides why an interruption is needed and when the preserved task should be resumed or dispositioned.

controls.purpose: Track machine isolation from user-global instruction/config surfaces without claiming ownership of the external user configuration.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent remains responsible for intended user-global configuration changes outside the isolated invocation.
controls.boundary: Invocation isolation is machine-controlled, but the user's global configuration is external state.

controls.purpose: Keep original user requirement ingress outside repository-local machine-enforcement claims.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent must preserve and interpret the user's current requirement when constructing repository task authority.
controls.boundary: The authoritative requirement originates in external conversation input.

controls.purpose: Bind worker execution to the captured Git authority snapshot and fail when protected Git authority changes unexpectedly.
controls.residual_parent_judgment: The parent decides the intended recovery when a Git authority mutation is detected.
